method.transfer: Ratio of S-NPP to MODIS active cell-days per H3 res 1 region and season (DJF, MAM, JJA, SON), fitted on 2012-02 to 2019-12, falling back to the res 0 parent and then the globe. Separate Terra-only ratio before 2002-10
method.viirs_group: Mean of S-NPP and NOAA-20 over those nominal in the month, the one available otherwise. NOAA-21 in the per-satellite values only
method.filters: Type 0 only, confidence nominal or high (MODIS: nominal 30 to 79, high 80 and above)
notes: Real FIRMS data: MODIS Collection 6.1 (Terra, Aqua) and VIIRS 375 m Collection 2 (S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21), archive download, Standard files plus near real-time files for the latest months. Data through 2026-11-14.

Per-cell harmonized values before 2012-02 come from a regional ratio. They are estimated, can exceed the days in the month, and are zero wherever MODIS saw nothing. Sums over areas are the reliable figure.

Band: 5th to 95th percentile of the regional ratio over 200 bootstrap resamples of the fit years. It is the calibration spread of the region, not a per-cell error. The leave-one-year-out table by scale gives the error by size of area.
Fit months: 93 months from 2012-02 to 2019-12 where S-NPP, Terra and Aqua are all nominal. Strata: 1198 res 1, 400 res 0 fallback, 466 global fallback (minimum 30 MODIS cell-days).
A satellite is nominal in a month when it has data on at least 100% of the days. Months from NOAA-20's start where the VIIRS series uses one satellite: 15.
NOAA-20 / S-NPP cell-days: 1.022. The fit target is S-NPP alone, so with the NOAA-20 scale not applied h steps by about x1.011 at 2018-04 and by x1.011 when S-NPP ends (decision D2: not applied).
Share of res 6 cell-months in the fit period with no MODIS day but an S-NPP day: 53%.
Baseline 2012 to 2025 (decision D4: VIIRS years only). 7-cell place-months in the fit period with no activity: 88% on MODIS, 79% on S-NPP.
Days are UTC acquisition dates. Detail (res 6) covers: World.

Optional daily fields (UTC days, proposed for contract v1) for Piedmont, Italy, Piedmont and neighbouring regions: day masks in detail tiles, [day, value] pairs per overview cell, daily series in the summary. Rule and weights in method.json "daily".
Method: the team decisions D1 to D17 of 2026-11-15 (MVP plan section 13, README "How the fire score works").
